text:
tasha: Pinging the group new design pass on Keys page. Main asks: make rotate vs revoke semantics crystal, add a safer bulk workflow, and nail keyboard focus for the undo toast. Figma: https://figma.com/snap/keys-new-flow. ben: Quick scan looks great. A few ideas: 1) a soft-schedule for revoke (like a 2-minute window) reduces accidental outages; 2) show an "impact heatmap" that highlights likely affected routes; 3) avoid full red for rotate. leo: Agree on soft-schedule. For enterprise customers, add a "Staged revoke" toggle (staging/prod) so they can trial revokes. Also: when rotating, copy the new key to ephemeral UI and show it for 10s before hiding for safety. sam: Accessibility + keyboard: when revoke is initiated, put focus on the queued-toast Undo button. Toast should be role=alert or status depending on assertiveness. If the row is removed after expiry, announce "API key removed" and move focus to filter/search. Also ensure modal escape behavior. tasha: Copy thoughts: revoke header "Revoke API key", body "This will invalidate the key. Requests using it may fail. You can undo within 2 minutes." CTA: "Revoke now" (destructive) secondary: "Cancel". Rotate header "Rotate key", body "Creates a replacement key. Old key remains active for 2 minutes to allow cutover." CTA: "Rotate and copy" secondary: "Cancel". ben: UX for bulk: if selection <=5 show inline preview and single confirm. If >5 require typed-confirmation ("REVOKE") and show impact estimate. For >50 show a warning tile and require a named approval step. leo: Visual hierarchy: permission chips are heavy. Compact summary: show "Perms: read,write +1" and expand on focus. Also add a small audit link per row: "Last used: 3d ago audit" which opens logs. sam: Small aria snippet for the Undo toast suggestion: ```html
Revocation scheduled for "billing-key".
``` Programmatically focus the Undo button when toast appears. tasha: On keyboard mnemonics: thinking of adding single-letter shortcuts when list is focused: R = rotate selected, V = revoke selected, M = open bulk menu. Need to vet with accessibility so it doesn't conflict with browser shortcuts. ben: Good idea but surface an off-ramp setting to disable shortcuts per user. Also, ensure shortcuts only work when list has focus. leo: For the ephemeral copy on rotate, include a copy-to-clipboard button that shows a brief tooltip: "Copied! (will hide in 10s)". Also record in audit log that rotation occurred and include who performed it. sam: Edge cases: 1) rotating a key used by CI jobs that read env vars may need a longer overlap window; consider making overlap configurable per workspace (default 120s). 2) revoking a key that's already scheduled for revoke should show "Already scheduled" and allow cancel of scheduled revoke. tasha: Implementation notes I'll include in the spec: - soft-schedule 120s default, configurable env flag - typed-confirm thresholds: >5 typed "REVOKE", >50 require approval - impact estimate tooltip text: "Estimate based on last 90 days of route usage" - ephemeral copy visibility 10s. ben: Copy nit: change "Requests using it may fail" to "Requests using it will fail" for revoke. Clearer. sam: Accessibility test checklist request: toast announced, undo focused, dialog traps focus, focus return after removal, keyboard shortcuts scoped and documented. I'll add these to the PR checklist. leo: One small UI microcopy: add a helper under rotate CTA: "Tip: rotate if you suspect compromise; revoke if you want to immediately cut access." Keeps users from picking the wrong action. tasha: Great. Action items: I'll update mocks with staged revoke toggle, soft-schedule toast, typed-confirm thresholds, and shortcut hints. Sam will add a11y checklist to the PR template; Ben will draft the impact tooltip copy; Leo will mock the ephemeral copy behavior. I'll drop updated frames in ~1h. Thanks! :sparkles: aria-bot: Design review created by tasha. Reviewers: ben, leo, sam. Deadline: 36h.
